HOME SCIENCE — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #10
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: HOME SCIENCE
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. A chemical reaction forming ash
   B. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   C. Movement of water only across a membrane
   D. Heating until a solid melts

2. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Planning Family Meals? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Planning Family Meals.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Planning Family Meals.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Planning Family Meals.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Planning Family Meals.

3. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Petrol fires have no fuel
   B. Water always increases oxygen
   C. Water removes heat too quickly
   D. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely

4. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Time and Energy Management? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Time and Energy Management.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Time and Energy Management.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Time and Energy Management.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Time and Energy Management.

5. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Laundering of Fabrics? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Laundering of Fabrics.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Laundering of Fabrics.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Laundering of Fabrics.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Laundering of Fabrics.

6. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Glucose and oxygen
   B. Nitrogen gas only
   C. Only water vapour
   D. Only carbon dioxide

7. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Control of Household Pests and Insects 2.4 Laundering of Fabrics 2.5 Interior De? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Control of Household Pests and Insects 2.4 Laundering of Fabrics 2.5 Interior De.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Control of Household Pests and Insects 2.4 Laundering of Fabrics 2.5 Interior De.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Control of Household Pests and Insects 2.4 Laundering of Fabrics 2.5 Interior De.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Control of Household Pests and Insects 2.4 Laundering of Fabrics 2.5 Interior De.

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Meal Service? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Meal Service.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Meal Service.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Meal Service.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Meal Service.

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Cake Making and Decoration? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Cake Making and Decoration.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Cake Making and Decoration.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Cake Making and Decoration.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Cake Making and Decoration.

10. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. watt (W)
   B. newton (N)
   C. joule (J)
   D. pascal (Pa)

11. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Personal Appearance and Etiquette? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Personal Appearance and Etiquette.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Personal Appearance and Etiquette.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Personal Appearance and Etiquette.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Personal Appearance and Etiquette.

12. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Control of Household Pests and Insects? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Control of Household Pests and Insects.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Control of Household Pests and Insects.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Control of Household Pests and Insects.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Control of Household Pests and Insects.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Planning Family Meals and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Meal Service and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Food Preservation and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Cake Making and Decoration and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
